name: Midnight Neon
signature: Near-black page, one mint-neon accent, grain glow, wide geometric type.

contrast.note: Dark theme. Neon mint is safe as text on both backgrounds. Dark labels on neon buttons pass AA. Never pair with a second neon color.

type.eyebrow: 0.75rem, weight 600, uppercase, 0.2em tracking, accent color, mono-feel digits

motion.rule: Glide: elements rise 28px over 650ms with a 80ms stagger, and the main button leans toward the pointer.

hero.layout: Large headline with the key word in accent. Behind it, a radial glow of the accent at 14% opacity from the top-right corner plus an SVG-noise grain overlay at 5%. A glowing outlined primary button and a quiet text link.
hero.photo: Real photo shown as a bordered 16px-radius card below the headline, not as the background.

background: Near-black with a 24px dot grid at 6% ink opacity. Surface-color cards with a 1px ink-at-8% border. Glow is static (a pseudo-element whose opacity is revealed), never animated blur.

button.fill: Accent fill, onAccent label; secondary is a 1px accent outline.
button.label: Weight 600, sentence case.
button.hover: A glow ring appears (opacity change on a pseudo-element); the button leans toward the pointer with data-magnetic.

banned: three identical glass cards in a row
